references.text: The earlier instruction that the Levites were to receive one-fiftieth from half of the Israelites, which is now carried out in this verse.
The service of the Levites at the tabernacle and their responsibility for caring for the holy equipment.
The Levites shall camp around the tent of the testimony and keep watch at the dwelling of the Lord.
The inheritance and support of the Levites through gifts from the people of Israel as compensation for their service at the tabernacle.
The service of the Levites at the tent of meeting and their duty to keep watch.
A concluding note that Moses did what the Lord had commanded him, as in this verse.
